output.summary: Turnover rose firm-wide, from 27.9% to 46.8%, and reconciles to payroll, so the HRIS artifact is contradicted. Cedar Hollow rose about 19 points against about 5 for peers, so the increase exceeds the labor-market effect. Pay was the top exit reason in both years, so it does not explain the change. The step-up began in March 2026 with the Saturday policy, before ShiftWise went live in April, and ShiftWise branches were chosen for high volume. Manager-of-record data is stale for seven branches, so the manager hypothesis cannot be tested. Overtime tracks open requisitions. The 15% pay increase is premature, and bonus withholding based on the stale manager field is harmful. Branch-level separations with corrected dates and a ShiftWise comparison are needed before committing; the ShiftWise expansion can be held at no fee.
